##### Project general facts

Dubai Creek Residences is a residential development by Emaar Properties, made up of six waterfront residential towers with a sophisticated structure and simple composition. The towers are anchored to a podium that sets the scene for a vibrant marina lifestyle, with a distinct form inspired by the charm of the creek.

The towers offer one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with exclusive penthouses on the top floors. Residents enjoy covered car parking, a daycare centre, a children's swimming pool, an adult pool and deck and a fully equipped gymnasium, along with a spacious lobby and round-the-clock security.

Interiors use stone, wood and other mineral materials to create a warm, organic palette with chic, contemporary compositions. The towers are encircled by yacht clubs, pools, a marina, a retail podium and a boulevard glowing with activity.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour is a waterfront district on the banks of Dubai Creek, next to the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The area is planned around a central boulevard, parks and a long creekside promenade, and it is well connected to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport via Ras Al Khor Road and Al Khail Road.

Residents have access to Creek Marina, Creek Beach and a range of cafés, restaurants and shops along the promenade, along with landscaped parks and cycling and jogging tracks. Supermarkets, clinics and nurseries are found within the community, while Dubai Festival City Mall and Dubai Design District are a short drive away.

The district attracts strong interest from professionals and families who want waterfront living close to the city centre, which supports healthy rental demand and resale activity. Property is freehold and open to international buyers, making Dubai Creek Harbour a popular choice for both end users and investors.
